\begin{lexlean}{Main}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.int@1.0.0}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.nat@1.0.0}
\useglossary{test.spec@1.0.0}
\title{Natural number addition}

\begin{section}{natural}
\heading{Natural number}
\parameters{natural number \(a\); natural number \(b\)}
  \begin{theorem}{nat-comm}
  \noaxioms
  \(a + b = b + a\).
  \begin{proof}
  Close the goal with \(natcomm(a, b)\).
  \end{proof}
  \end{theorem}
\end{section}

\begin{section}{integer}
\heading{Integer}
  \begin{theorem}{int-comm}
  \allowaxioms{propext}
  For every integer \(a\) and integer \(b\), \(a intplus b = b intplus a\).
  \begin{proof}
  Close the goal with \(intcomm(a, b)\).
  \end{proof}
  \end{theorem}
\end{section}
\end{lexlean}
